title: Decide full-separability preservation in the commuting correlated-dephasing class
statement: For the declared commuting Markovian class, covariance feasibility is equivalent to preserving every fully separable input for all times and supplies an explicit local classical implementation; infeasibility supplies a finite-time witness.

requires: m finite-dimensional parties, one nonconstant local Hermitian A_i per party, real symmetric U, C=R+iJ>=0 with R real symmetric and J real antisymmetric. Generator L(rho)=-i[(1/2)sum_ij U_ij A_i A_j,rho]+sum_ij C_ij(A_i rho A_j-(1/2){A_i A_j,rho}). Commuting local Hamiltonians are allowed.
Known specified coefficients for the structural decision problem; classical mediation means LOCC without pre-existing shared entanglement. This differs from the later raw-record discovery interface.
provides: There exist real diagonal D=diag(d),S=diag(s) with Sigma=[[D,-(U+S+J)/2],[-(U+S-J)/2,R-D]]>=0 iff exp(tL) preserves every fully separable input for every t>=0. One2m-by-2m PSD constraint uses2m real diagonal variables.

Feasibility gives local Gaussian-pointer measurements, classical messages and local phase feedback at finite channel time. For covariance h*Sigma, product Kraus operator K_xy=exp[sum_i(x_i+i y_i)A_i-h sum_i d_i A_i^2], with a local diagonal-Hamiltonian correction. Outcomes must have their actual BORN-WEIGHTED law; unweighted Gaussian draws are incorrect. Singular D uses the generalized Schur complement.

Necessity comes from every separable decomposition via completed normal/anomalous moments, not a Gaussian ansatz. Infeasibility makes local two-eigenlevel product superpositions non-fully-separable at sufficiently small positive time; dual witness plus second-derivative bound gives a certified finite time.
assumptions: Astra N1201 already supplies important positive-Gaussian finite-instrument machinery. The source addition is the necessity/equivalence for this declared complex correlated-noise class; no broader theorem is inherited or re-audited.
Matrix-size formulation is polynomial, not exact polynomial-bit decision arbitrarily near an ill-conditioned boundary. Rational strict-margin certificates are distinct from boundary feasibility.
costs: Actual pointer measurement, communication, phase feedback and specified finite-time control. Strict feasibility/infeasibility margins and numerical/bit conditioning remain.
contract.units: U,C generator coefficients; Sigma a real covariance matrix; h abstract channel time; finite-dimensional bounded local observables.
contract.obstruction: The structural theorem assumes finite-dimensional parties, one nonconstant local Hermitian observable per party, commuting bilinear interactions and correlated Markovian dephasing. It does not cover arbitrary Lindbladians, noncommuting local operator families, non-Markovian mediators or unbounded target observables. The coefficient-based SDP and raw-record test have different access contracts. Trusted local controls, known qubit structure, private randomization, corrected source-detector conditions and physical preparation resources remain necessary. Unknown detector response can erase power. No exact polynomial-bit decision near an ill-conditioned SDP boundary, estimator advantage over the same-moment covariance SDP or general dominance over measurement-device-independent witnesses is claimed.

body: No claim for arbitrary Lindbladians, multiple noncommuting local operators, non-Markovian mediation or unbounded observables. Source proof/report originals remain held.
